message.content: Based on the conversation, Li Hua seems to be supportive of improvisation during the jam sessions. In one of the discussions, Wolfgang Schulz suggests adding some improvisation to the jazz elements of their music, and Li Hua enthusiastically agrees, stating, "Sounds like a plan! Let’s see what we can blend together!" Additionally, Li Hua mentions being open to sharing any new ideas they come up with, indicating a willingness to explore different musical styles and improvisational elements. Li Hua's openness and enthusiasm suggest that she appreciates the creative aspects of improvisation in their musical collaborations.
